home.meta.title: Guesstimate — Estimates with uncertainty
home.meta.description: Guesstimate is a spreadsheet for estimates with uncertainty. Enter numbers or ranges, connect them with formulas, and calculate a distribution of results.
home.meta.social: Enter numbers or ranges, connect them with formulas, and calculate a distribution of results.
plans.meta.title: Plans — Guesstimate
plans.meta.description: Compare free public models, individual private models, and shared private models for organizations.
plans.meta.social: Free public models and paid plans for private models and organizations.
home.subtitle: A spreadsheet for things that aren’t certain.
home.note: No account needed to try. Scratchpad changes aren’t saved.
example.title: Example: project cost
example.text: You expect a project to take 40 to 60 hours, at $80 an hour. Guesstimate uses those numbers to work out a likely range for the total cost.
example.interval: 90% likely to fall in this range
example.caption: This example assumes the work will take around 50 hours, with shorter and longer times less likely. The ranges shown cover 90% of the possibilities in this estimate; the actual time and cost could fall outside them.
home.formulas.text: Connect cells as you would in a spreadsheet. For example, multiply hours by an hourly rate to estimate a cost. Change either number and the result updates.
home.results.text: See a range of possible answers and which are more likely, based on your estimates. The chart helps you see how much the result could vary.
home.saving.text: Create an account to save your work and share it with others. Public models are free. Paid plans let you keep models private, on your own or with a team.
plan.individual.short: {individualLimit} private models, visible only to you.
plan.organization.short: {organizationLimit} private models, shared with your team.
plans.intro: Public models are free. Choose a paid plan if you need to keep your work private, on your own or with a team.
plan.individual.description: For work you want to keep private.
plan.private: Private models are visible only to you
plan.members: Members can view and edit shared models
plans.signin: Sign in to choose a paid plan or manage your subscription.
faq.title: About the plans
faq.access.text: Anyone can view a public model. An individual private model is visible only to its owner. An organization’s private models are shared with its members.
faq.cancel: Can I change or cancel my plan?
faq.cancel.text: Plans are billed monthly. You can change or cancel your subscription through the payment portal in your account.
faq.after: What happens to private models if I cancel?
faq.after.text: Your private models become unavailable to view or edit until you subscribe again.
faq.payment.text: Visa, Mastercard, and American Express are accepted.
faq.discount: Are there education or nonprofit discounts?
home.ranges.text: Enter a number when you know it. When you’re unsure, enter a range such as {range}. You don’t have to settle on one number before you can start.
faq.model.text: A model is a spreadsheet containing your numbers, estimates, and calculations. You can try one in the {scratchpad} without an account.
faq.discount.text: Yes. {contact} to ask about a discount for your organization.
language.label: Language
language.notice: The app and documentation are currently in English.
